items.name: Davis Fall 2023

venue.name: [University of California-Davis ARC Conference Center](https://oem.ucdavis.edu/venues/arc-conference-center)
venue.details: Ballroom at the UC Davis ARC Conference Center

items.information: Get ready for UC Davis's first cubing competition! This competition has **four rounds of 3x3**! ### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.** ### **If you are under the age of 18, UC Davis will require a parent/guardian to sign a liability waiver. An email will be sent out before the competition with more details.** #### **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Lunch will end at the scheduled time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
